title: factblock.measurement/v1
description: One measurement of a causal edge's strength: a node in a bundle (SPEC 3.8, informative). Only the fields that make a node a measurement are listed; the rest are as for any node (SPEC 3.1), and unknown fields are kept (SPEC 7).

id.description: one id per vintage; a new measurement is a new node

statement.description: one sentence on what was measured

fact_key.description: shared by every vintage of one edge at one horizon; declared with policy latest_observed

edge_type.description: as written on the edge, e.g. CAUSES

regime.description: the edge's properties.regime, or null when it has none

path.description: reserved for results about a path of causal edges; shape not described yet

grade.description: evidence grade: 0 hypothesis only, 1 association or lead and lag, 2 event study with placebo test and control group, 3 narrow-window identification or difference in differences

method_hash.description: the writer's identifier for the exact method; opaque to readers

lfsr.description: local false sign rate; 1 - p_sign when both are present

post_sd.description: posterior standard deviation of the effect

half_life.description: half-life used to discount older data

cs_lo.description: lower bound of a confidence sequence

cs_hi.description: upper bound of a confidence sequence
